content:
I've done some digging on Github. From what I can tell it's specific to Pop connections.

It looks like for pop accounts , the capability to move emails from trash to Inbox was never implemented. Happy to be corrected if the feature was later added.

There is a feature enhancement ticket discussing it's addition but it was closed as the original K-9 developer planned to discontinue Pop3 support in the app. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/1796

Thunderbird have later stated in an unrelated ticket: "While we're not removing POP3 support at the moment, it isn't something we want to focus on" https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/9094#issuecomment-2842184393

There is an open ticket for your issue below where you can add your feedback. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/10922

Sorry it's not better news.
creator: platform34

content:
Thank you for digging up this information! :)

I think it is a important to be able to move back messages from the thrash, because it is a common mistake to move messages to thrash by accident. Also, I think it would probably be easier to solve the problem for POP3 than for IMAP, because for POP3 the move only has to be made locally while for IMAP the move has to be done on server level as well. So I think the error should have some more priority.

I will look at the open ticket for the issue and see if I can add feedback.
